title.zh: 卷三十八 志第十八: 地理一
title.raw: 卷三十八 志第十八: 地理一 Volume 38 Treatises 18: Geography 1

meta.sourceNote: Body restored from Wikisource juan 38 to match the ChineseNotes chapter heading. The previous Wikisource import used the file number instead of the traditional juan.

sentences.zh: 王者司牧黎元，方制天下。

translations.literal: The king governs and shepherds the common people, thereby administering the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign governs and shepherds the people, thereby administering the realm.

sentences.zh: 列井田而底職貢，分縣道以控華夷。

translations.literal: Arranging well-fields to secure tribute duties, dividing counties and districts to control the Chinese and the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Arranging well-fields to secure tribute, dividing counties and districts to govern the heartland and the frontier.

sentences.zh: 雖《皇墳》、《帝典》之殊塗，《禹貢》、《周官》之異制，其于建侯胙土，頒瑞剖符，外湊百蠻，內親九牧，古之元首，咸有意焉。

translations.literal: Although Huang Fen and Di Dian follow different paths, and the Tribute of Yu and the Offices of Zhou differ in their systems, in establishing marquises and granting fief lands, bestowing jade scepters and severing tally-seals, assembling the hundred barbarians outside and treating the nine pasture regions within as kin—all the ancient chiefs devoted thought to this.
translations.idiomatic: Though Huang Fen and Di Dian followed different paths, and the Tribute of Yu and the Offices of Zhou prescribed different systems, every ancient ruler devoted thought to enfeoffing lords, granting fiefs, bestowing imperial tokens and tally-seals, bringing the hundred barbarian peoples to the borders, and holding the nine pasture regions close at heart.

sentences.zh: 然子弟受封，周室竟貽於衰削；

translations.literal: Yet when sons and younger brothers received enfeoffment, the house of Zhou ultimately bequeathed decline and diminishment;
translations.idiomatic: Yet when sons and younger brothers received fiefs, the Zhou house ultimately bequeathed decline and diminishment;

sentences.zh: 郡縣為理，秦人不免於敗亡。

translations.literal: Taking counties and commanderies as the means of governance, the men of Qin could not escape defeat and ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Governing through counties and commanderies, Qin could not escape defeat and ruin.

sentences.zh: 蓋德業有淺深，制置無工拙。

translations.literal: For virtue and achievement have depth and shallowness; institutional arrangement has no skill or clumsiness.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue and achievement run deep or shallow; institutions are neither inherently wise nor foolish.

sentences.zh: 殷、周未為得，秦、漢未為非。

translations.literal: Yin and Zhou were not necessarily right; Qin and Han were not necessarily wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Yin and Zhou were not necessarily right, and Qin and Han were not necessarily wrong.

sentences.zh: 摭實而言，在哲後守成而已。

translations.literal: Gathering facts and speaking, it lies solely in a wise successor guarding what has been accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Stated on the facts alone, success depends on a wise successor who preserves what was achieved.

sentences.zh: 謹詳前代隆平之時，校今日耗登之數，存諸戶籍，以志休期。

translations.literal: Respectfully detailing the peaceful and flourishing times of previous generations, comparing today's numbers of decrease and increase, preserving them in household registers, in order to record an era of prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: I shall carefully detail the peaceful and flourishing eras of past dynasties, compare them with today's figures for decline and growth in the household registers, and record an age of prosperity.

sentences.zh: 昔秦並天下，裂地為四十九郡，郡置守尉，以御史監之。

translations.literal: In former times Qin united the realm, carved the land into forty-nine commanderies; each commandery had a governor and assistant, overseen by an inspector.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin united the realm, it divided the land into forty-nine commanderies, each with a governor and deputy overseen by an inspector.

sentences.zh: 其地西臨洮，而北沙漠，東縈南帶，皆際海濱。

translations.literal: Its territory bordered the Tao River on the west and the desert sands on the north; to the east it wound and to the south it stretched, all meeting the sea's edge.
translations.idiomatic: Its territory reached the Tao River in the west and the desert in the north; east and south it wound along the seashore.

sentences.zh: 漢興，以秦郡稍大，析置郡國。

translations.literal: When Han arose, because Qin commanderies were somewhat large, they were subdivided and additional princedoms and commanderies established.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han rose, it subdivided the somewhat oversized Qin commanderies and established additional commanderies and princedoms.

sentences.zh: 武帝斥越攘胡，土宇彌廣。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu repelled the Yue and expanded against the Hu; the territory became ever broader.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu drove back the Yue and pressed against the northern peoples, greatly expanding the domain.

sentences.zh: 哀、平之季，凡郡國百有三，縣千三百一十四，道三十二，侯國二百四十一，而諸郡置十三部刺史分統之。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperors Ai and Ping, in total there were 103 princedoms and commanderies, 1,314 counties, 32 districts, and 241 marquisates; and over the commanderies were established thirteen regional inspectorates to govern them separately.
translations.idiomatic: By the reigns of Emperors Ai and Ping, there were 103 commanderies and princedoms, 1,314 counties, 32 districts, and 241 marquisates, overseen by thirteen regional inspectorates.

sentences.zh: 謂司隸、幷、荊、兗、豫、揚、冀、青、徐、益、交、涼、幽等十三州。

translations.literal: Namely the thirteen provinces of Directorate of the Capital, Bing, Jing, Yan, Yu, Yang, Ji, Qing, Xu, Yi, Jiao, Liang, and You.
translations.idiomatic: These were the thirteen provinces: Directorate of the Capital, Bing, Jing, Yan, Yu, Yang, Ji, Qing, Xu, Yi, Jiao, Liang, and You.

sentences.zh: 漢地東西九千三百二里，南北一萬二千三百六十八里。

translations.literal: Han territory measured 9,302 li east to west and 12,368 li north to south.
translations.idiomatic: Han territory measured 9,302 li from east to west and 12,368 li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 後漢郡國，百有五，縣道侯國千一百八十六。

translations.literal: Later Han had 105 princedoms and commanderies, and 1,186 counties, districts, and marquisates.
translations.idiomatic: Later Han had 105 commanderies and princedoms, with 1,186 counties, districts, and marquisates.

sentences.zh: 亦如西京之制，置十三州刺史以充郡守。

translations.literal: Likewise following the Western Capital system, thirteen provincial inspectors were established to replace commandery governors.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Western Capital system, it likewise established thirteen provincial inspectors in place of commandery governors.

sentences.zh: 其地廣袤，亦如前制。

translations.literal: The breadth and length of its territory likewise followed the former system.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial extent likewise followed the earlier standard.

sentences.zh: 曹魏之時，三分鼎峙，淮、漢之間，鞠為鬥壤。

translations.literal: In the time of Cao-Wei, the realm was divided three ways like tripod cauldrons standing opposed; between the Huai and Han Rivers the land became battle ground.
translations.idiomatic: During Cao-Wei, the realm split three ways; between the Huai and Han the land became a battleground.

sentences.zh: 洎太康混一，尋陷胡戎。

translations.literal: By the time of the Great Peace era there was reunification, but soon it fell to the northern barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Reunification came in the Taikang era, but soon the land fell to northern peoples.

sentences.zh: 南北分爭，何暇疆理？

translations.literal: North and south contended in division—who had leisure for territorial administration?
translations.idiomatic: With north and south locked in contention, who had time to administer the borders?

sentences.zh: 三百年間，廢置不一。

translations.literal: Over three hundred years abolitions and establishments were not uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Over three centuries, abolitions and reestablishments followed no single pattern.

sentences.zh: 及隋氏平陳，寰區一統，

translations.literal: When the house of Sui pacified Chen, the entire realm was unified.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sui pacified Chen, the whole realm was unified.

sentences.zh: 改州為郡，亦如漢制，置司隸、刺史，以糾郡守。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daye, prefectures were changed to commanderies; likewise following Han institutions, the Directorate of the Capital and regional inspectors were established to supervise commandery governors.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Daye, prefectures became commanderies; as in Han times, the Directorate of the Capital and regional inspectors were established to oversee commandery governors.

sentences.zh: 大凡隋簿，郡百九十，縣一千二百五十五，戶八百九十萬七千五百三十六，口四千六百一萬九千九百五十六。

translations.literal: In general according to the Sui registers: 190 commanderies, 1,255 counties, 8,907,536 households, and a population of 46,019,956.
translations.idiomatic: According to Sui registers in general: 190 commanderies, 1,255 counties, 8,907,536 households, and 46,019,956 persons.

sentences.zh: 其地東西九千三百里，南北一萬四千八百一十五里。

translations.literal: Its territory east to west was 9,300 li; north to south was 14,815 li.
translations.idiomatic: Its territory measured 9,300 li east to west and 14,815 li north to south.

sentences.zh: 東、南皆際大海，西至且末，北至五原，隋氏之極盛也。

translations.literal: East and south both reached the great sea; west to Qimo, north to Wuyuan—this was the Sui house at its greatest flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: East and south reached the sea; west to Qimo and north to Wuyuan—this was the Sui at its height.

sentences.zh: 及大業季年，群盜蜂起，郡縣淪陷，戶口減耗。

translations.literal: By the closing years of the Daye reign era, bandits rose like swarming bees; commanderies and counties fell, households and population declined.
translations.idiomatic: By the last years of the Daye era, rebels rose everywhere; commanderies and counties fell, and population dwindled.

sentences.zh: 高祖受命之初，改郡為州，太守並稱刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning when Gaozu received Heaven's mandate, commanderies were changed to prefectures, and governors were all called regional inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu first received the Mandate, commanderies became prefectures and governors were all restyled regional inspectors.

sentences.zh: 其緣邊鎮守及襟帶之地，置總管府，以統軍戎。

translations.literal: At frontier garrison posts and strategically important regions, overall command offices were established to govern military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontier and at strategic choke points, overall command offices were set up to direct military affairs.

sentences.zh: 至，改總管府為都督府。

translations.literal: By the seventh year of Wude, overall command offices were changed to area-command offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Wude, overall command offices were renamed area-command offices.

sentences.zh: 自隋季喪亂，群盜初附，權置州郡，倍於開皇、大業之間，，悉令並省。

translations.literal: Since the disorders at the end of Sui, when bandit groups first submitted, prefectures and commanderies were established provisionally at twice the number of the Kaihuang and Daye eras; in the first year of Zhenguan, orders were given to merge and reduce them all.
translations.idiomatic: After the disorders at Sui's end, as rebel bands first submitted, provisional prefectures and commanderies were set up at twice their Kaihuang and Daye numbers; in the first year of Zhenguan, all were ordered merged and reduced.

sentences.zh: 始于山河形便，分為十道：一曰關內道，二曰河南道，三曰河東道，四曰河北道，五曰山南道，六曰隴右道，七曰淮南道，八曰江南道，九曰劍南道，十曰嶺南道。

translations.literal: Beginning with natural boundaries of mountains and rivers, the realm was divided into ten circuits: first the Guannei Circuit, second the Henan Circuit, third the Hedong Circuit, fourth the Hebei Circuit, fifth the Shannan Circuit, sixth the Longyou Circuit, seventh the Huainan Circuit, eighth the Jiangnan Circuit, ninth the Jiannan Circuit, and tenth the Lingnan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning from natural boundaries of mountains and rivers, the realm was divided into ten circuits: Guannei, Henan, Hedong, Hebei, Shannan, Longyou, Huainan, Jiangnan, Jiannan, and Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 至十三年定簿，凡州府三百五十八，縣一千五百五十一。

translations.literal: By the thirteenth year the registers were fixed: in all 358 prefectures and superior prefectures, and 1,551 counties.
translations.idiomatic: Registers fixed in the thirteenth year listed 358 prefectures and superior prefectures and 1,551 counties.

sentences.zh: 至十四年平高昌，又增二州六縣。

translations.literal: By the fourteenth year, when Gaochang was pacified, two more prefectures and six counties were added.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, with the pacification of Gaochang, two prefectures and six counties were added.

sentences.zh: 自北殄突厥頡利，西平高昌，北逾陰山，西抵大漠。

translations.literal: From the north destroying the Türk leader Jiali, pacifying Gaochang in the west, crossing the Yin Mountains to the north and reaching the great desert in the west.
translations.idiomatic: After destroying the Türk leader Jiali in the north and pacifying Gaochang in the west, the realm crossed the Yin Mountains and reached the great desert.

sentences.zh: 其地東極海，西至焉耆，南盡林州南境，北接薛延陀界。

translations.literal: Its territory reached the sea in the east, Yanqi in the west, the southern border of Lin Prefecture in the south, and bordered the Xueyantuo in the north.
translations.idiomatic: Its territory reached the sea in the east, Yanqi in the west, the southern limits of Lin Prefecture in the south, and the Xueyantuo border in the north.

sentences.zh: 凡東西九千五百一十里，南北萬六千九百一十八里。

translations.literal: In all, 9,510 li east to west and 16,918 li north to south.
translations.idiomatic: In all, it measured 9,510 li east to west and 16,918 li north to south.

sentences.zh: 高宗時，平高麗、百濟，遼海已東，皆為州，俄而復叛，不入提封，

translations.literal: In Gaozong's time, when Goguryeo and Baekje were pacified, all lands east of the Liao Sea became prefectures, but soon they rebelled again and did not enter the imperial domain.
translations.idiomatic: Under Gaozong, Goguryeo and Baekje were pacified and lands east of the Liao Sea were made into prefectures, but they soon rebelled again and did not enter the imperial domain.

sentences.zh: 分天下郡縣，置二十四都督府以統之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingyun, the commanderies and counties of the realm were divided and twenty-four area-command offices were established to govern them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingyun, the realm's commanderies and counties were divided and twenty-four area-command offices were established to govern them.

sentences.zh: 議者以權重不便，尋亦罷之。

translations.literal: Critics held that their powers were too weighty and inconvenient; soon they were also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Critics found their authority too heavy and inconvenient, and they were soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 至德之後，中原用兵，刺史皆治軍戎，遂有防禦、團練、制置之名。

translations.literal: After the Zhide era, as the Central Plain waged war, regional inspectors all administered military affairs, and thereafter there came the titles of defense command, training command, and provisional command.
translations.idiomatic: After the Zhide era, with war in the Central Plain, regional inspectors all took charge of military affairs, and the titles defense command, training command, and provisional command appeared.

sentences.zh: 要衝大郡，皆有節度之額；

translations.literal: Important strategic great commanderies all had military commission quotas;
translations.idiomatic: Major strategic prefectures all carried military commission quotas;

sentences.zh: 寇盜稍息，則易以觀察之號。

translations.literal: When bandits and robbers gradually subsided, the title was changed to surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When banditry eased, the title was changed to surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 上元年後，河西、隴右州郡，悉陷吐蕃。

translations.literal: After the Shangyuan era, the prefectures and commanderies of Hexi and Longyou all fell to the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: After the Shangyuan era, the Hexi and Longyou prefectures and commanderies all fell to Tibet.

sentences.zh: 大中、咸通之間，隴右遺黎，始以地圖歸國，又析置節度。

translations.literal: Between the Dazhong and Xiantong eras, the remaining people of Longyou first returned to allegiance with maps, and military commissions were again divided and established.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Dazhong and Xiantong eras, the surviving people of Longyou first returned their maps to the throne, and new military commissions were carved out.

sentences.zh: 今舉地理。

translations.literal: Now I set forth the geography.
translations.idiomatic: Here I present the geography.

sentences.zh: 唐土東至安東府，西至安西府，南至日南郡，北至單于府。

translations.literal: Tang territory extends east to Andong Superior Prefecture, west to Anxi Superior Prefecture, south to Rinan Commandery, and north to Chanyu Superior Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tang territory extends east to Andong, west to Anxi, south to Rinan, and north to Chanyu.

sentences.zh: 南北如前漢之盛，東則不及，西則過之。

translations.literal: North and south match the flourishing of Former Han; to the east it does not reach as far, to the west it surpasses it.
translations.idiomatic: North and south it matches Former Han at its height; to the east it falls short, to the west it exceeds it.

sentences.zh: 漢地東至樂浪、玄菟、，今高麗、渤海是也。

translations.literal: Han territory extended east to Lelang and Xuantu; today's Goryeo and Bohai are that region.
translations.idiomatic: Former Han reached east to Lelang and Xuantu—the region now held by Goryeo and Bohai.

sentences.zh: 今在遼東，非唐土也。

translations.literal: Today it lies in Liaodong; it is not Tang territory.
translations.idiomatic: It now lies in Liaodong and is not Tang territory.

sentences.zh: 漢境西至燉煌郡，今沙州，是唐土。

translations.literal: Han borders extended west to Dunhuang Commandery; today's Shazhou is Tang territory.
translations.idiomatic: Han borders reached west to Dunhuang; today's Shazhou is Tang territory.

sentences.zh: 又龜茲，是西過漢之盛也，

translations.literal: Moreover Kucha—this is west of Han at its greatest flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Kucha lies still further west, beyond Former Han at its greatest extent.

sentences.zh: 戶部計帳，凡郡府三百二十有八，縣千五百七十有三。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Kaiyuan, according to the Ministry of Revenue's accounts, in all there were 328 commanderies and superior prefectures, and 1,573 counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Kaiyuan, Ministry of Revenue accounts listed 328 commanderies and superior prefectures and 1,573 counties.

sentences.zh: 羈縻州郡，不在此數。

translations.literal: Jimi prefectures and commanderies are not counted in this number.
translations.idiomatic: Jimi prefectures and commanderies are not included in this count.

sentences.zh: 戶八百四十一萬二千八百七十一，口四千八百一十四萬三千六百九，應受田一千四百四十萬三千八百六十二頃一十三畝。

translations.literal: Households 8,412,871, population 48,143,609, land eligible for allotment 14,403,862 qing and 13 mu.
translations.idiomatic: There are 8,412,871 households, a population of 48,143,609, and 14,403,862 qing and 13 mu of land subject to allotment.

sentences.zh: 雖未盈兩漢之數，晉、魏以來，斯為盛矣。

translations.literal: Although it has not yet filled the numbers of both Han dynasties, since Jin and Wei it is the greatest flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Though still short of both Han dynasties' totals, it is the greatest prosperity since Jin and Wei.

sentences.zh: 永泰之後，河朔、隴西，淪於寇盜。

translations.literal: After the Yongtai era, the north of the Yellow River and Longxi fell to bandits and robbers.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yongtai era, the north of the Yellow River and Longxi fell to rebellion and brigandage.

sentences.zh: 元和掌計之臣，嘗為版簿，二方不進戶口，莫可詳知。

translations.literal: The officials in charge of accounts in the Yuanhe era once made block registers; the two regions did not submit household registers, so none could know in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanhe officials in charge of accounts once compiled registers, but the two regions filed no household returns, so the figures cannot be known in detail.

sentences.zh: 今但自武德已來，備書廢置年月。

translations.literal: Now I only from the Wude era onward fully record the years of abolition and establishment.
translations.idiomatic: Here I record only the years of establishment and abolition since the Wude era.

sentences.zh: 其前代沿革，略載郡邑之端。

translations.literal: For the evolution of prior dynasties, I briefly set forth the beginnings of commanderies and districts.
translations.idiomatic: For earlier dynasties I briefly note the origins of commanderies and districts.

sentences.zh: 俾職方之臣，不殆于顧問耳。

translations.literal: So that officials of territorial administration may not be at a loss when consulted.
translations.idiomatic: So that territorial officials may not be at a loss when consulted.

sentences.zh: 十道郡國

translations.literal: The Commanderies and Principalities of the Ten Circuits
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies and Principalities of the Ten Circuits

sentences.zh: 關內道一 河南道二

translations.literal: Guannei Circuit, first; Henan Circuit, second
translations.idiomatic: I. Guannei Circuit; II. Henan Circuit

sentences.zh: 京師秦之咸陽，漢之長安也。

translations.literal: The capital was Qin's Xianyang and Han's Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: The capital occupies the site of Qin's Xianyang and Han's Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 隋，自漢長安故城東南移二十里置新都，今京師是也。

translations.literal: Under Sui, from the old Han Chang'an city moving twenty li southeast a new capital was established; today's capital is that city.
translations.idiomatic: Under Sui, the capital was moved twenty li southeast from old Han Chang'an; today's capital stands there.

sentences.zh: 城東西十八里一百五十步，南北十五里一百七十五步。

translations.literal: The city measures 18 li and 150 paces east to west, 15 li and 175 paces north to south.
translations.idiomatic: The city measures 18 li and 150 paces east to west, and 15 li and 175 paces north to south.

sentences.zh: 皇城在西北隅，謂之西內。

translations.literal: The Imperial City is in the northwest corner; it is called the Western Inner Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial City stands in the northwest corner and is called the Western Inner Palace.

sentences.zh: 正門曰承天，正殿曰太極。

translations.literal: The main gate is called Chengtian; the main hall is called Taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Its main gate is Chengtian; its main hall is Taiji.

sentences.zh: 太極之後殿曰兩儀。

translations.literal: Behind Taiji, the rear hall is called Liangyi.
translations.idiomatic: The rear hall of Taiji is called Liangyi.

sentences.zh: 內別殿、亭、觀三十五所。

translations.literal: Within are thirty-five separate halls, pavilions, and viewing towers.
translations.idiomatic: Within it are thirty-five separate halls, pavilions, and towers.

sentences.zh: 京師西有大明、興慶二宮，謂之三內。

translations.literal: West of the capital are the Daming and Xingqing two palaces; together they are called the Three Inner Palaces.
translations.idiomatic: West of the capital stand the Daming and Xingqing palaces; together they are called the Three Inner Palaces.

sentences.zh: 有東西兩市。

translations.literal: There are eastern and western markets.
translations.idiomatic: The city has eastern and western markets.

sentences.zh: 都內，南北十四街，東西十一街。

translations.literal: Within the capital, fourteen streets north to south and eleven streets east to west.
translations.idiomatic: Within the capital are fourteen streets running north-south and eleven running east-west.

sentences.zh: 街分一百八坊。

translations.literal: The streets divide into 108 wards.
translations.idiomatic: The streets divide the city into 108 wards.

sentences.zh: 坊之廣長，皆三百余步。

translations.literal: The breadth and length of wards are all over 300 paces.
translations.idiomatic: Each ward measures more than 300 paces on every side.

sentences.zh: 皇城之南大街曰硃雀之街，東五十四坊，萬年縣領之。

translations.literal: The great street south of the Imperial City is called Vermilion Bird Street; the fifty-four wards to the east are administered by Wannian County.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Imperial City runs Vermilion Bird Street; the fifty-four wards to the east fall under Wannian County.

sentences.zh: 街西五十四坊，長安縣領之。

translations.literal: West of the street are fifty-four wards, administered by Chang'an County.
translations.idiomatic: West of the street lie fifty-four wards under Chang'an County.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹總其事。

translations.literal: The Jingzhao Intendant oversees it all.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingzhao Intendant supervises all of it.

sentences.zh: 東內曰大明宮，在西內之東北，高宗置。

translations.literal: The Eastern Inner Palace is called Daming Palace; it is northeast of the Western Inner Palace; Gaozong established it.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Inner Palace is Daming Palace, northeast of the Western Inner Palace; Gaozong built it.

sentences.zh: 正門曰丹鳳，正殿曰含元，含元之後曰宣政。

translations.literal: The main gate is called Danfeng; the main hall is called Hanyuan; behind Hanyuan is Xuanzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Its main gate is Danfeng; its main hall is Hanyuan; behind Hanyuan stands Xuanzheng.

sentences.zh: 宣政左右，有中書門下二省、弘文史二館。

translations.literal: To the left and right of Xuanzheng are the two bureaus of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and the Hongwen and Historical Archives.
translations.idiomatic: To either side of Xuanzheng stand the Secretariat and Chancellery bureaus and the Hongwen and Historical Archives.

sentences.zh: 高宗已後，天子常居東內，別殿、亭、觀三十餘所。

translations.literal: After Gaozong, the Son of Heaven regularly dwelt in the Eastern Inner Palace; separate halls, pavilions, and towers number more than thirty.
translations.idiomatic: After Gaozong, the Son of Heaven regularly lived in the Eastern Inner Palace, which has more than thirty separate halls, pavilions, and towers.

sentences.zh: 南內曰興慶宮，在東內之南隆慶坊，本玄宗在籓時宅也。

translations.literal: The Southern Inner Palace is called Xingqing Palace; it is in Longqing Ward south of the Eastern Inner Palace; originally it was Xuanzong's residence when he was a prince.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Inner Palace is Xingqing Palace, in Longqing Ward south of the Eastern Inner Palace; it was originally Xuanzong's residence as prince.

sentences.zh: 自東內達南內，有夾城復道，經通化門達南內。

translations.literal: From the Eastern Inner Palace reaching the Southern Inner Palace, there is an elevated passageway within the city walls, passing through Tonghua Gate to reach the Southern Inner Palace.
translations.idiomatic: An elevated passageway within the walls runs from the Eastern Inner Palace through Tonghua Gate to the Southern Inner Palace.

sentences.zh: 人主往來兩宮，人莫知之。

translations.literal: When the ruler traveled between the two palaces, no one knew of it.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler could move between the two palaces unobserved.

sentences.zh: 宮之西南隅，有花萼相輝、勤政務本之樓。

translations.literal: In the southwest corner of the palace are the towers "Tower of Blossoming Calyx Mutual Splendor" and "Tower of Diligent Governance and Rooting in Fundamentals."
translations.idiomatic: In the palace's southwest corner stand the "Tower of Blossoming Calyx Mutual Splendor" and the "Tower of Diligent Governance and Rooting in Fundamentals."

sentences.zh: 禁苑在皇城之北。

translations.literal: The Forbidden Park is north of the Imperial City.
translations.idiomatic: The Forbidden Park lies north of the Imperial City.

sentences.zh: 苑城東西二十七里，南北三十里，東至灞水，西連故長安城，南連京城，北枕渭水。

translations.literal: The park walls measure 27 li east to west and 30 li north to south; east to the Ba River, west connecting to the old Chang'an city, south connecting to the capital city, north resting on the Wei River.
translations.idiomatic: The park measures 27 li east to west and 30 li north to south, reaching the Ba River in the east, connecting to old Chang'an in the west, adjoining the capital in the south, and resting on the Wei River in the north.

sentences.zh: 苑內離宮、亭、觀二十四所。

translations.literal: Inside the park are twenty-four detached palaces, pavilions, and viewing towers.
translations.idiomatic: Within the park are twenty-four detached palaces, pavilions, and towers.

sentences.zh: 漢長安故城東西十三里，亦隸入苑中。

translations.literal: The old Han Chang'an city, 13 li east to west, is also subordinate and incorporated into the park.
translations.idiomatic: Old Han Chang'an, 13 li east to west, is also incorporated into the park.

sentences.zh: 苑置西南監及總監，以掌種植。

translations.literal: The park has a Southwest Supervisor and a Chief Supervisor to manage planting.
translations.idiomatic: The park has southwest and chief supervisors to manage cultivation.

sentences.zh: 安邑、夏縣，天寶後，加管戶一萬八千五百。

translations.literal: Anyi and Xia Counties, after the Tianbao era, had added to their jurisdiction 18,500 households.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tianbao era, Anyi and Xia Counties gained an additional 18,500 households under their jurisdiction.
